message: Hey neighbors! 🌟 I’ve been diving into fire preparedness lately—because you never know when a little knowledge might come in handy. The Red Cross has some solid tips on how to get ready for fire emergencies, and honestly, it’s all about being gloriously over-prepared! It’s like wearing a raincoat on a sunny day; you might look a bit silly, but you’ll be the one laughing if the clouds roll in. How do you stay ready for the unexpected?
